aggregation: Equal user means for per-user metrics; cohort-wide coverage and exposure
candidate_policy: RecBole full-sort catalogue excluding padding and training and validation history
checkpoint_format: SHA-256 of canonical JSON mapping of portable bundle file hashes

group_construction.activity: Linear training-count terciles; ties stay together; zero-history users join low
group_construction.gender: Recorded F/M user metadata; preparation pending with Caio/Victor
group_construction.item_popularity: Training interaction shares 20/60/20, with complete count buckets

metric_definitions.CatalogueCoverage: Distinct recommended movies / checkpoint catalogue size
metric_definitions.ExposureGini: Gini over all catalogue movies, including zeros; exposure = 1/log2(rank + 1)
metric_definitions.GRU: Absolute F/M mean accuracy gap, with both means and signed F-minus-M difference
metric_definitions.GenreMiscalibration: KL(p || 0.99*q + 0.01*p), natural log; equal movie weights and fractional genres
metric_definitions.ILD: Mean unordered-pair Jaccard distance between movie genre sets; undefined for K=1
metric_definitions.ItemGroupExposure: Discounted exposure total, share, and per-movie exposure in each popularity group
metric_definitions.UPD: Base-2 Jensen-Shannon divergence of unweighted training/recommendation head/middle/tail shares

pending_work.metadata: Caio/Victor: metadata preparation is not implemented; genres, genre profiles and recorded gender are unavailable

profile_weights: Equal interactions; each movie contributes equal total genre mass
